scene_summary: Compact contemporary living room with a tan velvet sofa on the left, a dark foreground coffee table, a low oak-and-white media console on the right, and a bright balcony door framed by charcoal curtains.
environment_description: The apartment living room has warm off-white plaster walls, a muted olive-taupe right wall, a white ceiling, and continuous medium warm-grey fitted carpet. A mustard-tan velvet sofa faces a glossy black television mounted against a pale oak-effect architectural wall panel, above a low wood-and-white console. A dark espresso wood coffee table holds two ivory cups and a closed cream-covered book. Nearly black charcoal curtains and translucent white sheers flank the black-framed balcony glazing, with horizontal balcony rails visible against the overexposed exterior. No season is discernible; the sparse indoor plants have deep green leaves without autumn colours. Strong neutral daylight from the rear glazing backlights the furnishings and creates soft warm shadows toward the camera.

palette.season_evidence: Interior scene with an overexposed exterior and no reliable seasonal evidence.

palette.ground_words: Medium warm-grey fitted carpet with dense finely textured pile.
palette.sky_words: Overexposed white daylight beyond the balcony glazing, without distinct sky detail.
